profile.description: 这是一种基于数字微镜器件（DMD）的高速图案投影与空间光调制设备，可按位图或预定义序列输出光学图案。实验室中常用于结构光照明、图案投影、光学调制以及需要精确时序触发的成像和曝光实验。
profile.description_en: This is a digital micromirror device (DMD) based high-speed pattern projection and spatial light modulation unit that outputs optical patterns from bitmaps or predefined sequences. In laboratories it is commonly used for structured illumination, pattern projection, optical modulation, and imaging or exposure experiments that require precise timing and triggering.
